sentences.en: The commander gave orders that his men fire at once.
sentences.zh: 指挥官下令他的士兵立即开火。

sentences.en: He rose in rank to become commander of the battalion.
sentences.zh: 他晋升为营长的指挥官。

sentences.en: They were beginning to lose faith in their commander.
sentences.zh: 他们开始对他们的指挥官失去信心。

senses.zh: 指挥官，长官；海军中校；英国高级警官；高级骑士（或爵士）
